# Honora Hollis

[Delford](../codex/places.md#delford)

## Overview

- **Role:** teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Varley](../character/varley.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Honora Hollis is a fair and ethereal-appearing young woman with radiant blonde hair. She has been seen wearing silk clothing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Honora Hollis possesses a fair and ethereal appearance that belies her true nature. She is thoroughly filled with humor, jokes, and mischief.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Honora Hollis attended Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), though she later wrote a letter stating she was employed at her home school. On a spring Saturday, she explored the woods with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), discovering a hidden, flower-filled garden and spending the afternoon discussing nature and poetry. Honora was later forced to cancel a planned visit to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), but she eventually joined [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md), and Mrs.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P6](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0006), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), +12 more_

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/honora-hollis--nell-harcourt.md)

Honora and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends and driven scholars who share social outings and quiet days together. They spend time alongside mutual companions exploring the woods, discovering hidden locations like an abandoned garden, and discussing poetry, nature, and deep personal topics over lunch. On another occasion, Honora sends [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) a letter to cancel a planned visit following an accident at Nell's home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +15 more_

- Friend of — close friends and driven scholars  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +3 more</sub>

### [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/honora-hollis--odette-pullen.md)

Honora and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) are friendly companions who share a spring day trip outdoors alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde. During their excursion, they explore the woods, discover an abandoned garden by a pool they name [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and eat lunch by a brook. Together, they spend the day conversing about nature and poetry before gathering flowers and walking home at sunset.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P6](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0006), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), +6 more_

- Comrade of — friends taking a spring day trip together in the woods (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003)</sub>

### [Varley](../character/varley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/honora-hollis--varley.md)

Honora is the niece of Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md). Honora joins Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for a social dinner and a stroll hosted by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), +4 more_
